query: What aspects of their experience are Yelp reviewers talking about?

per_column.name: service_sentiment
per_column.rationale: Directly captures a key experiential aspect (service) with sentiment, giving a strong axis to group and compare reviews. Values match the samples well: positive for Oliveo/Michelle, negative for the forgotten-party and cabana reviews.

per_column.name: service_failure_type
per_column.rationale: Categorizes specific service failures, a genuinely useful sub-axis for understanding negative experiences. 'forgotten_by_staff' for YLP-0002 is well grounded; YLP-0005 (gave away cabana, refused entry) is arguably a failure but marked not_present, a minor miss but not a hallucination.

per_column.name: food_product_sentiment
per_column.rationale: Captures food/product sentiment, a core aspect distinct from service. Mostly grounded. YLP-0005 marks food negative from 'Drinks sucked' (reasonable). YLP-0002 marks food negative though the review focuses on service and no clear food complaint appears in the excerpt—mildly under-supported.

per_column.name: product_quality_dimension
per_column.rationale: Identifies which quality dimension is discussed (flavor, temperature, preparation, etc.), a valuable new axis. YLP-0003 as preparation_technique (wood-oven crust) is sound; YLP-0001 flavor_taste is reasonable. Grounded across samples.

per_column.name: value_pricing_sentiment
per_column.rationale: Value/pricing is a distinct, useful aspect. YLP-0003 mentions price ($20/single serve) so positive_value is plausible. YLP-0001 marked positive_value on 'free pita' is a stretch but warranted. Generally grounded with a few thin inferences.

judge.rationale: The added columns decompose the vague query 'what aspects are reviewers talking about' into concrete, non-redundant experiential dimensions (service, food, quality, value) each with sentiment and typed sub-categories—exactly the grouping/comparison leverage the analysis needs. None are near-constant or trivial. Values are largely sound readings of the source text with correct use of not_present for silent rows; only minor over-inferences (e.g., YLP-0002 food negative, YLP-0001 value from free pita) slightly reduce groundedness. No fabricated facts observed.
